description: Offline knowledge pack — Smartass / Georgian AI demo
facts: Smartass is a Georgian artificial intelligence demo assistant.
The product brand line is: Hello! I'm a Georgian artificial intelligence! Smartass
This chat UI is a living-cell visual demo with voice, API keys (Gemini / OpenAI / Claude), and offline Brain AI Lab packs.
Georgia (Sakartvelo) uses the Georgian language; the assistant prefers matching the user's language.
Brain AI Lab packs download into the browser (localStorage) so the chat can use offline facts without a network call.
